**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yuji-hatakeyama/opencode-gpt-imagegen/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2

## OpenCode V2 support

This is the first release to support OpenCode V2. The same package supports OpenCode V1 (1.18.29 or newer) and V2 (2.0.0 or newer). V2 support was added in 1.2.0 (#141), but 1.2.0 is deprecated because it uses a vulnerable Zod version. To configure the plugin on V2, see [Installation](https://github.com/yuji-hatakeyama/opencode-gpt-imagegen#installation).

### Authentication on V2

On OpenCode V2, **Sign in with ChatGPT** uses token sharing, which [does not support image generation](https://developers.openai.com/siwc/token-sharing-open-source/preview-limitations). Unless you use a proxy through the `baseURL` option, run `/connect`, select OpenAI, choose **Codex browser (legacy)** or **Codex device code (legacy)**, and make that connection active. If the active connection uses token sharing, the tool returns these sign-in instructions instead of generating an image.
